docs: Adapted from seamui haptics (MIT, Mikhail Villamor, commit 7c57149f327d). web-haptics is not a dependency. Nothing vibrates on mount. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
